title: Get job-ready this festive season with the HMRC app
text:
• Thousands starting seasonal jobs encouraged to use the HMRC app for the job-related information they need.

 • Survey results show a third of people lack confidence with job-related paperwork when changing jobs.

 • One in five jobseekers delayed starting a job because they were unsure about their tax.

 As thousands of people start seasonal jobs, HM Revenue and Customs ( HMRC ) is encouraging them to download the HMRC app to get the tax and employment information they need.

 Last year, almost 80,000 people started a job in November and, while HMRC survey results show one in three respondents went online to understand how tax worked when they started working, 36% said they lack confidence when it comes to the paperwork they need.

 The survey, commissioned by HMRC into the digital habits of more than 5,200 people, also showed:

 • one in five delayed starting a job because of confusion about tax or paperwork

 • 45% of people relied on family or friends to explain tax when they started their first job

 For young people applying for their first job during their Christmas break or those looking for a second job to boost their seasonal budget, with the HMRC app, they can be confident they have all the job-related detail they need to hand.

 Jobseekers can quickly and easily find their National Insurance number, tax code, employment history and Pay As You Earn (PAYE) details – everything needed for application and new starter forms to ensure they get paid the correct amount when they start earning.

 People can also check their pay in the app a few days before it lands in their bank, especially important at this time of the year when budgets are tight.

 The HMRC app can be downloaded from GOV.UK or from the App Store or Google Play.

 Myrtle Lloyd, HMRC ’s Chief Customer Officer said:

 Christmas is a hectic and expensive time and often jobs such as delivery driving, retail work and hospitality need someone to start quickly. The HMRC app has your tax and income details to hand and can mean you start earning without any delay.

 Of the millions who were working last November and December, one in nine were aged 18-24.

 And more young people are reaching for the HMRC app as the survey reveals that one in five young people use the app when changing or starting jobs, more than any other age group.

 HMRC ’s Tax Confident website is a useful resource for jobseekers, providing clear and simple information in one place to help them understand money matters including information about tax and paying tax on their earnings.

 Further Information

 HMRC -commissioned survey carried out between 27 February and 12 March 2026 into the digital habits of 5,206 consumers.

 Monthly employment by age can be found in the Labour Market Statistics .

 Online reviews for the HMRC app is currently 4.8 stars on the App Store, and 4.6 stars on Google Play.
